extra_misconceptions.fact: Mechanical safeties are internal parts that can fail, so muzzle direction must always remain pointed downrange or in a safe direction.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Engaging the mechanical safety on a shotgun makes it safe to point the muzzle in any direction on the range.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Birdshot travels up to three hundred yards and retains enough velocity at close and medium range to blind or seriously injure bystanders.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Small birdshot pellets lose all kinetic energy within fifty yards and cannot cause injury beyond the target area.

extra_misconceptions.fact: You must never touch an unattended firearm; instead, stop your friend, leave the room immediately, and report it to a responsible adult.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: If a friend finds an unattended shotgun in a closet, unloading the chamber yourself is the safest first step.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Shooters must wear ANSI Z87.1 rated wraparound safety glasses to block high velocity clay fragments, unburned powder, and ejected hulls.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Ordinary prescription eyeglasses provide sufficient impact and side protection when shooting clay targets on a windy day.

extra_socratic_questions: What sequence of actions must you take immediately if a friend brings out an unsecured shotgun when no adults are home?

extra_misconceptions.fact: Gauge equals the number of bore-sized lead balls per pound, making a 12-gauge bore wider in diameter than a 20-gauge bore.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: A 20-gauge shotgun has a larger bore diameter than a 12-gauge shotgun because the gauge number is higher.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Shotgun shooting requires keeping both eyes open focused on the leading edge of the moving target while pointing the barrel naturally.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Aiming a shotgun by closing your non-dominant eye and aligning sights like a rifle improves accuracy on moving clays.

extra_misconceptions.fact: You must keep the muzzle pointed downrange and wait at least 30 seconds in case a delayed hangfire ignites the powder charge.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: When a shotshell fails to fire after the trigger is pulled, you should rack the pump immediately to eject the dud shell.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Smokeless powder generates excessive chamber pressure that can rupture a muzzleloader barrel; use only black powder or approved substitutes.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Modern smokeless powder can be poured safely into a muzzleloading shotgun barrel if measured by volume.

What measurement on a 30-inch patterning circle at 40 yards confirms whether a choke delivers a full or modified spread?

extra_misconceptions.fact: Serving as a Certified Range Safety Officer requires reaching age 21 and completing the official NRA Range Safety Officer training course.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Earning the Shotgun Shooting merit badge qualifies a Scout to serve as an official Range Safety Officer at camp.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Recurring costs for cases of shotshells, clay target fees, association dues, and tournament entry fees quickly exceed the price of the gun.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: The initial purchase price of a competition shotgun represents the largest long-term expense in competitive clay target sports.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Conservation officers are commissioned peace officers who must graduate from a state police academy and complete wildlife biology coursework.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: State conservation officers and game wardens only enforce hunting bag limits and do not require formal law enforcement training.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Anyone engaged in the business of repairing or modifying firearms for profit must obtain a Federal Firearms License from the ATF.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Any hobbyist who cleans shotguns can legally operate a commercial gunsmithing business from home without federal licensing.
